dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello, my stomach hurts really bad...
{WHAT'S YOUR ADDRESS?} What is your address, sir?
It's [[ADDRESS]]
13 Raspberry Road
104 8th Alley
64 Frotemond Plaza
{WHAT'S YOUR NAME?} And your name?
My name is Kevin Rogerson.
I'm Steve Walters.
My name's Seth Dorts.
{HOW LONG?} So how long have you had this stomach pain?
About an hour ago....it started suddenly.
I've been feeling awful since morning, but it feels like it's getting worse by the hour.
Hmm... it's about two weeks, I guess.
{DOES ANYTHING ELSE HURT YOU?} Does anything else hurt?
No... I can't feel anything except the pain in my belly.
I have a terrible headache.
I vomited half an hour ago.
{DID YOU DRINK ALCOHOL?} Sir, have you drank alcohol lately?
What? No! I'm not hangover!
Well... I went to a party last night and... maybe I drink a bit too much...
Only a glass of wine during dinner.

{IT'S NOT AN EMERGENCY} Sir, that's probably the result of having too much alcohol last night, I think that's the reason. I can't send an ambulance in such situation. So here is my advice: Wait a couple of hours, if the pain is still there or it increases get yourself to the emergency room at the hospital, OK?
What?! Is this a joke to you? I can barely make it to the toilet and you tell me to wait?
{CALM DOWN} Sir...
I've heard enough. Bye.
Okay, I guess you're right. Bye.
{WHAT DID YOU EAT?} Have you eaten anything unusual lately, sir?
No, just what I always eat.
Hm, I don't know.... I've eaten a burrito, but I don't know if it counts as unusual.
Well... maybe it's because of those mushrooms...
{WHY DIDN'T YOU VISIT A DOCTOR} So why haven't you gone to a doctor, sir?
I was busy. There were so many things to do...
I didn't think it would get so bad. But the pain didn't go away and now it's even worse!
I wasn't able to do it. I took a few days off at work, but the pain was so overwhelming... I literally haven't got out of my bed since Tuesday.
{SEE A DOCTOR} You should go visit a doctor as soon as possible. 911 is for emergencies I hope you understand that, so I can't send an ambulance in this kind of case.
{ANY OTHER SYMPTOMS?} Do you have any other symptoms?
Umm...I also have diarrhea.
I looked in the mirror and my skin's very pale, I have chills and I can't stop sweating
No, I don't think so.
{FOOD MIGHT BE THE REASON} Are you sure about quality of that food that you had? Maybe you have an indigestion.
I haven't been to that restaurant before... and, now that I think about it, the burrito didn't taste right...but I ate it anyway.
It's not about the food...
{GO TO A DOCTOR} Probably there's nothing to worry about. Although, I think you should contact your doctor if the pain doesn't go away.
Sure. Thank you! Bye.
Seriously? I knew I could go to the doctor before I called you. Thanks for nothing!
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE}Okay, I'll send an ambulance to you.
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE} Sir, there is a possibility that you ate a poisonous mushroom. I'll send an ambulance immediately.
Oh, God... what have I done?!?... Please... get the ambulance here fast!
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE} Your symptoms could be a sign of something really serious. I'm gonna get you medical help as soon as possible.
Thank you... thank you very much. I'll wait for them to get here. Bye.
Ohhhh, my stomach!
Oh... can you help me?

reportElement.texten: The caller had a severe stomach ache.
He had symptoms that might've been a sign of a serious disease.
He had an indigestion. Medical help was not necessary.
The stomach ache did not appear suddenly and caller should visit a doctor. A medical intervence wasn't necessary.
The stomach ache was caused by alcohol and medical help wasn't needed.
The operator decided to send an ambulance.
The operator decided that the case was not urgent enough to send emergency medical services.
